entities.summary: Neringa or Neringa Municipality is a municipality of Klaipėda County in westernmost Lithuania, comprising several villages in the Curonian Spit. In terms of population, it is the second smallest municipality of the country. Nida is the seat of government and largest settlement in Neringa Municipality.
